label: Premium buyers
description: Fine dining, hotels and specialty shops that pay for quality and provenance.

label: Mainstream buyers
description: Grocery shoppers and casual restaurants who want reliable supply and fair prices.

label: Price-sensitive buyers
description: Buyers who choose on cost and need steady volume.

label: Institutional buyers
description: Schools, hospitals and cafeterias buying large steady volumes at low cost.

label: Export-oriented buyers
description: Traders shipping to overseas markets, often paying for higher grades in bulk.
